verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 108.7 (+7.7% in a day) and momentum is 52: prices are steady. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,000 and 86s 4,300. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-16T20:27:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Capdevila 86 Base Hero after its 19% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 142,000 coins. Now 142,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 19.3% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 2 so far, averaging +5.0% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy Selma Bacha 86 after its 32% fall, sell in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 12,250 coins. Now 12,750. Buy the dip: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often recovers part of the fall within two days. Picked because it is down 31.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 0 of 2 so far, averaging -15.9% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,000 (0.95 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,300 (1.05 coins per Item Score point), 87s 5,700 (1.04 coins per Item Score point), 88s 10,750 (1.30 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Park Ji Sung and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Park Ji Sung 86 Base Hero -74.8%; Mateus Fernandes 85 Destined for Glory -68.0%; Myles Lewis-Skelly 78 Rare -66.7%; Héctor Bellerín 76 Rare -62.9%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
